newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM slides on disappointing 96 prelim net.
newsitem.headline: DSM slides on disappointing 96 prelim net.

text.p: Shares in Dutch chemicals group DSM NV lost 5.10 guilders to 175.50 guilders at the opening on disappointment over the group's 1996 preliminary figures.
DSM said it expected 1996 net profit from ordinary operations to be at least 700 million guilders.
Analysts had forecast a net profit from normal operations of 738 to 800 million guilders, compared with a year-earlier 1.073 billion guilders. The consensus was at 750 million guilders.
Shares in the company soon recovered somewhat to trade at 178.00 guilders, then fell to 175.00, below their opening level.
Shares in Akzo also opened lower, trading at 263.00 guilders, off 3.20 guilders from Monday's close.
